name: crashdx
description: Diagnoses Apple crash reports (.ips): symbolicates against dSYMs and produces an evidence-cited, ranked diagnosis instead of just a stack trace.
long_description: crashdx parses .ips crash reports, symbolicates them against dSYMs, and runs a deterministic, rule-based diagnosis engine on top: typed facts extracted from the report feed a set of hypothesis rules, ranked by supporting and contradicting evidence. Every claim traces back to a JSON pointer in the original report, and the engine reports 'inconclusive' rather than force a confident wrong answer. No LLM calls anywhere in the engine itself; runs entirely locally with no network access.

tools.name: crashdx_analyze
tools.description: Parse, symbolicate, and diagnose an .ips crash report, returning a ranked diagnosis with the evidence behind it.

tools.name: crashdx_symbolicate
tools.description: Symbolicate an .ips crash report against its dSYM and return the enriched report.
